goal: Make the controlled BabySteps performance journey cover every safe deterministic scenario while reporting healthy zero, conditional, unavailable, success, and failure states truthfully before any AWS resources are created.
nonGoals: Manufacturing layout shifts, JavaScript errors, promise rejections, long tasks, wallet signatures, token approvals, swaps, or chain transactions merely to fill the dashboard
Treating controlled-browser observations as real-user production monitoring
Starting AWS Runtime before the complete local coverage gate passes
Changing shared VPC, NAT, RDS, OIDC, IAM foundation, Cloudflare production, or AWS Free-plan status
Publishing secrets, raw wallet addresses, tokens, cookies, signatures, request bodies, or personal data
networkScope: Read-only GitHub and official documentation during local implementation
No AWS Runtime or Cloudflare write until local N6 gates pass and the release phase is explicitly entered
acceptanceCriteria: The controlled-browser coverage gate runs before any CloudFormation, ECR, ECS, SQS, Lambda, database schema, or other AWS project resource creation
Required deterministic metrics have real accepted samples and valid units plus p50, p75, and p95 readback
Healthy runs may report zero long tasks, JavaScript errors, promise rejections, hydration recovery, and CSR fallback without manufacturing failures
Wallet, identity, signing, approval, receipt, and swap metrics remain conditional unless the prerequisite is safely and explicitly available
DNS, TCP, TLS, cache-reuse, and similar environment-dependent metrics distinguish unavailable or observed-zero from missing instrumentation
The safe Sepolia quote scenario proves a settled success or a settled sanitized failure and never lets an error suffix masquerade as a successful base metric
Transaction instrumentation records failure when approve, swap, or receipt fails instead of swallowing the error as success
Resource probes are self-contained in Git and work from a clean checkout
All routes and 375, 390, 430, and 1440 pixel views have no pageerror or root horizontal overflow, and reviewed visual baselines are not blindly updated
Evidence records provenance, route, environment, build, window, device conditions, sample counts, percentiles, freshness, limitations, and zero-residue status without overstating completion
